summary: The candidate clearly attempts the intended ask-slide structure with a left hero ask block, right milestone stack, and bottom use-of-funds ribbon inside the Designer shell, but the slide is not presentation-ready because the layout is visibly broken, content overlaps heavily, and the footer/logo contract is violated by an extra broken image replacing the standard shell logo treatment.
evidence: The locked header and subheader are present and use the requested wording: “Raising $1.25M…” and “Post-money SAFE • ~18–20 months of runway.”

The main figure follows the requested high-level logic: one integrated master card with a left ask panel, three right-side milestone cards labeled Build / Deploy / Validate, and a bottom use-of-funds ribbon with percentages.
The left hero block surfaces the ask first with “$1.25M,” “Post-money SAFE,” and support stats including “2 hires” and “3 pilots,” matching the proof-stage financing intent.
However, the header area is crowded and overlapping: the long title wraps into multiple lines and the subheader sits on top of the title descenders, reducing legibility.
The lower portion is severely broken: the ‘2 hires’ and ‘3 pilots’ stats collide with body copy and the bottom ribbon cards, and the closing sentence overlaps the ribbon content.
The right milestone cards are also clipped/overstuffed, with bullet text cut off at the bottom of at least the Deploy and Validate cards.
A broken image placeholder appears in the bottom-right corner, while the official Designer footer logo position is not preserved cleanly, violating the locked shell/footer requirement.
The slide no longer feels clinically polished or fully resolved because of visible overflow, clipping, and stacking errors.
nextPrompt: Keep the same overall concept, but rebuild slide 13 so it is presentation-ready within the locked Designer shell: preserve the exact header/subheader, keep one integrated master card, reduce type sizes and rebalance spacing so no text overlaps or clips, keep the left ask block to amount/instrument/3 stats only, keep the right Build/Deploy/Validate cards to concise outcome-first copy, make the bottom use-of-funds ribbon quieter and fully readable, and restore the standard footer rule and Designer logo with no extra/broken image element.
